name: no-embedded-template-assets
body: The kalide binary's embedded content is exactly the core of the tool: the vendored reveal.js runtime, the deck/error/gallery page shells, the minimal `kalide init` seed tree (written to disk once by no-arg init) and the static, text-only `AGENTS.md` scaffold guide files (requirements.requirement.agent-authoring) — the shared deck-author guide written by `kalide init` and `kalide init <path>`, and the library/template-author guide written by `kalide init-library`. Every template, theme and media file used for validating, rendering, listing or serving a deck is read at run time from the resolved library root — the configured `templates:` path in `kalide.yaml` when set, otherwise the local `templates/` directory (see external-template-library). The binary holds no templates, themes, fonts, logos or other presentation media (images, video, …), and there is no built-in fallback: a resolved library that lacks something is an error. The vendored runtime and page shells are core, not template assets; the scaffold guide files are scaffold content, not template assets, and are never referenced as one (and only the init seed tree is ever written to disk). None of the embedded content carries a brand (global.constraint.core-unbranded).
